title: Learnware and AI Model Management System
abstract: arXiv:2609.11656v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The transition from file storage to database management systems transformed stored data into managed resources. AI now faces an analogous transition from AI model storage to AI model management. Existing model pools essentially serve as \textit{AI model storage systems}. What is needed instead are \textit{AI model management systems} that enable models trained by different developers, for different tasks, with different data, and under different objectives to be identified, reused, and even assembled to address future user tasks. Because AI model developers are generally unwilling to share their training data, such systems should operate without accessing the training data of model developers and, ideally, without accessing raw data of future users. This requirement poses a fundamental challenge: the functionality of a modern AI model may not be fully understood even by the developer who trained it. How, then, can a system identify which

translated_abstract: 从文件存储到数据库管理系统的转变，将存储的数据变成了受管理的资源。如今，AI正面临着从AI模型存储到AI模型管理的类似转变。现有的模型池本质上只是AI模型存储系统，而我们真正需要的是AI模型管理系统——它能够识别、复用甚至组装由不同开发者、针对不同任务、使用不同数据、在不同目标下训练的模型，以应对未来的用户任务。由于AI模型开发者通常不愿共享其训练数据，此类系统应在不访问模型开发者训练数据的情况下运行，理想情况下也不应访问未来用户的原始数据。这一要求带来了一个根本性挑战：现代AI模型的功能即使对其训练者而言也可能无法被完全理解。那么，系统如何能够识别（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出从“AI模型存储”到“AI模型管理”的范式转变，基于学件（learnware）概念构建AI模型管理系统，使不同开发者、不同任务、不同数据下训练的模型在无需访问训练数据的情况下被识别、复用和组装。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a paradigm shift from AI model storage to AI model management, leveraging the learnware concept to build systems that can identify, reuse, and assemble models trained by different developers for different tasks—without accessing their training data.
